createTrigger-triggerId.label: Trigger
createTrigger-triggerId.tip: Create a trigger object corresponding to the file ID

createTrigger-caster.label: Caster
createTrigger-caster.tip: This actor can be accessed through "Skill Caster" in the trigger events

createTrigger-angle.label: Angle
createTrigger-angle.tip: Initial angle of this trigger, 0 degrees = right, clockwise rotation

createTrigger-distance.label: Distance
createTrigger-distance.tip: Distance this trigger is offset from initial position along initial angle (actual position)

createTrigger-scale.label: Scale
createTrigger-scale.tip: Scaling factor for trigger's shape and animation (can be used as attack range)

createTrigger-timeScale.label: Global Speed
createTrigger-timeScale.tip: Playback speed for this trigger and animation (can be used as attack speed)
